page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7ix.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal server designed for GPU-accelerated workloads and high-performance computing. It features 128 dedicated physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores operating at 2.9 GHz, with a single thread per core configuration. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB per core.

The primary acceleration hardware consists of eight NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 192 GB of VRAM. This massive parallel processing capability is paired with a high-speed network interface that provides a baseline network bandwidth of 160 Gbps. The server does not include local storage, requiring external block storage or network-attached storage solutions for data persistence.

Given its dense GPU configuration and high-performance dedicated CPU cores, this server is optimized for workloads such as deep learning training, large-scale AI inference, 3D rendering, and complex scientific simulations. The absence of hyperthreading ensures predictable, dedicated compute performance per core, which is highly beneficial for parallelized mathematical computations and real-time rendering pipelines.
